attempts.certificate: 按密钥循环分组逐位查表。加密：A(IJ)→W，H(GH)→R，P(EF)→E，M(KL)→U，N(AB)→Z，B(EF)→Z，G(IJ)→P，L(GH)→V，得 WREUZZPV。解密：W(QR)→E，V(UV)→F，N(UV)→K，T(WX)→E，P(KL)→H，F(QR)→X，T(UV)→D，G(UV)→W，U(WX)→F，得 EFKEHXDWF。

judges.reason: Both requested results follow the specified position-wise substitution tables. Encryption gives A→W, H→R, P→E, M→U, N→A, B→Z, G→P, L→V, hence [[WREUAZPV]]; decryption gives [[EFKEHXDWF]]. The supplied attempt is wrong on item 1 because it maps N under the AB table to Z instead of A, although item 2 is correct.
judges.depth_evidence: Each character is obtained by a direct lookup in the table selected by the corresponding repeated key letter; no dependent inference or branching is necessary.
judges.explanation_evidence: The certificate provides checkable position-wise table lookups and correctly derives the second answer, but its first derivation contains a demonstrable lookup error: N under AB maps to A, not Z. Therefore it is only partly checkable.
